concept_name: Ocean Voyager 280 — high-capacity cruise-ship stress case

mission.mission_statement: A large ocean cruise ship that minimises whole-trip lifecycle impact per passenger-night while maintaining comfort, service reliability, accessibility, evacuation capability and resilience across long voyages.
mission.operating_region: Multi-region ocean itineraries; port-specific limits and energy infrastructure vary and must be explicitly mapped.
mission.route_profile: Benchmark stress case with 7–14 day voyages and variable port dwell, shore-power access, weather and energy-carrier availability.

target_cruise_speed_kn.rationale: Provisional schedule-speed input for trade studies; not a validated power/speed point.

target_range_nmi.rationale: Provisional range stress target, subject to itinerary, reserves, weather routing and refuelling.

voyage_duration_days.rationale: Upper end of initial concept itinerary envelope.

port_calls.rationale: Illustrative stop count only; the final port sequence drives air draft, berth, supply and shore-power constraints.

length_overall_m.rationale: Scale class selected to stress-test high hotel load, crowd flow, mass and infrastructure limits.

beam_m.rationale: Set through compartmentation, stability, layout, structural and resistance studies.

design_draft_m.rationale: Port, canal, underwater appendage and loaded-draft constraints not yet mapped.

air_draft_m.rationale: Must account for ports, bridges and optional high-mounted wind devices.

displacement_tonnes.rationale: Requires a full mass, centre-of-gravity, tankage and growth-margin budget.

guest_capacity.rationale: Provisional capacity tier used to stress-test energy, water, food, waste and evacuation demand.

crew_capacity.rationale: Determine from service model, safe manning and emergency organization.

vehicle_or_cargo_capacity.rationale: No vehicle/cargo function assumed; add only if mission and layout require it.

operating_profile.sea_state_envelope: Build regional and seasonal hindcast scenarios plus design environmental criteria; no safe limits inferred from this concept.
operating_profile.weather_routing: Optimise route/speed with comfort, schedule, storm avoidance, reserve, environmental limits and passenger-service constraints as hard gates.
operating_profile.speed_policy: Compare punctuality-led, energy-led and weather-flexible schedules on the same itinerary and service assumptions.

availability_target.rationale: Provisional operational target; must be substantiated with maintenance, redundancy and port/weather interruption modelling.

energy_architecture.distribution_architecture: Compare zonal medium-voltage electric distribution and independent essential/emergency buses with protection selectivity and black-start analysis.
propulsion_candidates: efficient mechanical or diesel-electric matched baseline
multi-source electric architecture preserving future-fuel and shore-power options
energy_carriers_to_evaluate: methanol with lifecycle and safety assessment
LNG sensitivity case including methane-slip and lifecycle accounting
hydrogen/fuel-cell option only if storage, efficiency and space constraints close

battery_capacity_mwh.rationale: Large capacity cannot be specified without route power/time series, reserve, thermal-runaway zoning, mass and charging feasibility.

energy_architecture.shore_power: Model shore connection power, capacity factor, simultaneous berth demand, grid carbon intensity, costs and port availability across the route network.
energy_architecture.wind_assist: Investigate wind assistance only as an explicit constrained variant; deck operations, lifeboats, visibility, wind loading and air draft may dominate feasibility.
energy_architecture.solar_assist: Treat deck/roof solar as incremental; quantify usable area, shading, mass, maintenance and seasonal power rather than treating it as primary cruise propulsion.
energy_architecture.thermal_integration: Deep integration of HVAC zoning, heat pumps, hot/cold storage, waste-heat recovery, refrigeration, laundry, galley and desalination.

propulsion_kw.rationale: Need verified resistance, propulsor, sea-state and speed power maps.

hotel_kw.rationale: Need occupancy/service-mode loads with diversity factors measured or justified.

hvac_kw.rationale: Need climate-region, cabin/venue occupancy, ventilation, envelope and thermal storage simulation.

freshwater_kw.rationale: Need passenger/crew water demand, desalination and recovery/reuse design.

waste_treatment_kw.rationale: Need passenger-volume, treatment, discharge and retention/storage design.

galley_kw.rationale: Need total food-service, refrigeration, laundry and peak kitchen demand.

port_mode_kw.rationale: Must include simultaneous hotel, charging, cargo/service operations and grid limits.

load_budget.basis: Model hourly or finer demand for full service cycles; separate energy sources, conversion losses, auxiliary systems and the lifecycle boundary.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Match passenger capacity, itinerary, service quality, schedule, route weather and lifecycle boundaries.
performance_targets.validation_method: Independent route-energy and life-cycle model with explicitly sourced fuel, electricity and construction/replacement factors.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Where adequate shore power or verified zero-direct-emission supply actually exists.
performance_targets.validation_method: Port-specific power availability and emissions-factor ledger; verify onboard generator shutdown conditions.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Maintain equivalent passenger service, climate comfort, cuisine, water/waste service and timetable.
performance_targets.validation_method: Coupled hull, propulsor and hotel-load model calibrated on relevant reference vessels.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: No violation of declared stability, evacuation, fire, port, energy reserve or environmental hard constraints.
performance_targets.validation_method: Fault-injection and boundary-adversarial suite; unknown remains indeterminate.

hard_constraints.description: Passenger-ship statutory safety applicability, safety management, lifesaving, fire protection and emergency preparedness.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Qualified flag/class analysis and approved design evidence for applicable rules.

hard_constraints.description: Crowd flow, accessible routes, evacuation/muster capacity, lifts and essential service operation during emergencies.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Crowd modelling, evacuation validation, accessibility review and required approval.

hard_constraints.description: Intact/damage stability with high occupancy, tank states, wind loading, flooding and loading variations.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Approved stability analyses and loading-envelope validation.

hard_constraints.description: Segregated essential services, fault isolation, black-start, emergency power and machinery redundancy.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Protection/selectivity studies, failure-mode analysis and integrated-system tests.

hard_constraints.description: Sewage/garbage, emissions, bilge, ballast and other pollution obligations on all intended routes.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Flag/class/port compliance matrix and evidence from approved treatment systems.

hard_constraints.description: Draft, air draft, berth, shore power and emergency access for every intended port.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Validated port geometry and infrastructure dataset with explicit unsupported-route handling.

assumptions.statement: Whole-trip hotel loads and HVAC may dominate more of the design opportunity as passenger capacity grows.
assumptions.falsification_method: Measure and model each major load family; report both kWh/passenger-night and total route energy.

assumptions.statement: A modular electric energy backbone creates useful flexibility across shore power, battery buffering and alternative onboard sources.
assumptions.falsification_method: Compare fault-tolerant power topologies and pathway-specific efficiency, mass, space, cost and safety.

assumptions.statement: Some wind-assist concepts may remain feasible on a large passenger ship after layout and operational constraints are accounted for.
assumptions.falsification_method: Run 3D arrangement, stability, air-draft, evacuation/lifeboat and route-wind feasibility before crediting energy savings.

provenance.title: Hurtigruten Sea Zero project page
provenance.scope: Project-specific reported concept features, R&D and energy-reduction claims; comparator anchor only, not independent in-service data.

provenance.title: IMO SDC 12 ship-design and construction workplan
provenance.scope: Published workplan milestones for safety frameworks concerning selected energy-transition technologies; must re-check before approval.

provenance.title: IMO passenger ship safety and environmental standards
provenance.scope: Public overview of applicable passenger-ship safety and MARPOL requirements; not a compliance checklist.

provenance.title: ITTC Practical Guidelines for Ship CFD Applications
provenance.scope: Reference for ship CFD verification, validation, uncertainty and applicability; exact test data/use rights must be checked.

claim_ceiling: Concept stress case only. No geometric feasibility, displacement, energy balance, emissions reduction, passenger capacity approval, safety, seaworthiness or class compliance is established.
